name: Sun Moon Studio

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: Thursday to Sunday; a 20% service charge and tax are added; beverage pairing $125, non-alcoholic pairing $60

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable only. Tables are released on a rolling basis six weeks ahead, to the day, at 12pm California time. A card is needed to book.
cancellation: Cancelling three days or fewer before the booking, not turning up, or cutting the party size at any time costs $75 a person. Bookings can't be moved to another date but can be passed to someone else by email. Tables are held for 10 minutes.
waitlist: No waiting list of its own: use OpenTable's Notify Me alert for the date.
groups: Up to six guests per booking. Seven to 14 guests need a whole-restaurant buyout; email events@sunmoonstudio.com about two months ahead.
children: Young children are discouraged unless they can eat the full tasting menu.
duration: Two to two and a half hours.
byob: Corkage is $40 per 750ml bottle, up to two bottles per party.
